t: When you say you will do something
a: وَلَا تَقُولَنَّ لِشَا۟ىْءٍ إِنِّى فَاعِلٌ ذَٰلِكَ غَدًا إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ وَقُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَهْدِيَنِ رَبِّى لِأَقْرَبَ مِنْ هَـٰذَا رَشَدًا
p: Wa lā taqūlanna li-shay'in innī fāʿilun dhālika ghadā, illā an yashā'a-llāh…
m: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow," Except [when adding], "If Allāh wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
